commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) is booked.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' 3 - 0 Goal! Asier Villalibre gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 3:0.
90' Alvaro Negredo (Cadiz) fails to beat the offside trap. The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle.
87' A yellow card for a tackle by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz). Guillermo Cuadra doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
81' That's the end of the game for Oihan Sancet, who is replaced by Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao).
81' Here's the change. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta leaves the pitch and Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) comes on as a substitute.
78' Sergio has decided to substitute Ruben Alcaraz and he is replaced by Alex Fernandez (Cadiz).
77' The referee signals a substitution. Alvaro Negredo (Cadiz) is brought on as a substitute for Chris Ramos.
76' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

76' Conan Ledesma is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), pushing the ball around the post to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
73' Cadiz CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

73' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Unai Simon easily deals with the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Cadiz CF are going to take it.
68' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) replacing Aitor Paredes.
68' That will be all from Gorka Guruzeta who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao).
68' 2 - 0 An unlucky rebound falls to Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) and he scores with a bullet header.
66' 1 - 0 Goal! A great cross from Oscar de Marcos finds Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao), who scores with a simple header into an empty net. 1:0.
63' The substitution has been made. Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) has replaced Alex Berenguer.

62' Conan Ledesma pulls off a decent save! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ivan Alejo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Robert Navarro (Cadiz).
59' Sergio prepares a substitution. Ruben Sobrino is replaced by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz).
59' The substitution is prepared. Darwin Machis (Cadiz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Roger Marti.
57' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post.
57' Ath Bilbao force their opponents to concede a corner.
53' Ath Bilbao quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
52' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Ath Bilbao force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
50' Yellow card! It's like Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Guillermo Cuadra agrees and books him.
49' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
49' A cross into the box from Roger Marti (Cadiz) is cleared.
46' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Fali (Cadiz) for a tough tackle.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+3' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao win a corner kick.
45+2' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Guillermo Cuadra pulls out a yellow card.
45+1' The free kick from long range, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
43' What a chance that is! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!
40' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Guillermo Cuadra saw the whole situation.
39' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
36' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
31' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) serves up a nice cross, but Conan Ledesma punches the ball away.
30' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is adjudged offside.
29' A cross from Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
28' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar!

25' What a chance that is! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!

24' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His header would have probably ended up in the middle of the goal, but Conan Ledesma pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
24' The referee blows his whistle as Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) was too aggressive in his challenge. Ath Bilbao get a free kick.
23' The free kick from long range, taken by Cadiz CF, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
22' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Guillermo Cuadra no option but to blow his whistle.
19' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
18' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
16' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
15' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
13' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Guillermo Cuadra who sees an offensive foul.
11' Roger Marti (Cadiz) is flagged for offside.
9' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball in, but Conan Ledesma comfortably gathers the ball.
8' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
7' The resulting corner from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
6' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Ath Bilbao win a corner.
5' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) picks up a rebound in space and tries his luck from long range, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cadiz CF.
3' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Cadiz CF manage to earn a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Cadiz CF will have the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra was nominated as the referee for this game.
